input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 provides evergreen automatic one-year renewals with a 90-day non-renewal notice window. The 12-month renewal term is acceptable, but the 90-day window exceeds both our preferred 30-day and fallback 60-day limits and sits at the walk-away boundary, and there is no vendor reminder before renewal. Fees are revenue-share based on Net Sales with no unilateral uplift mechanism, so no price-increase cap is needed. Redline shortens the window to 30 days and requires HDI to give a renewal reminder 60 days before each anniversary.

proposal.summary: Shorten non-renewal notice window from 90 to 30 days and add HDI renewal reminder 60 days before each anniversary
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have shortened the non-renewal notice window from 90 days to 30 days and added a reminder from HDI 60 days before each renewal, consistent with our position that automatic 12-month renewals must be easy to exit. We can accept up to 60 days' notice as a fallback, but not 90.

ops.oldText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
ops.newText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon thirty (30) days written notice to the other. HDI shall give the Company written notice of each such upcoming automatic renewal no less than sixty (60) days prior to the applicable anniversary of the Effective Date.
